description: Reads the messages of one private chat thread, newest first, as the connected (stored) session. Takes a thread's `room_id` from the thread list. Paged: the previous response's `next_cursor`, sent as `before`, reads older messages. Billed at the DM read rate per page.

before.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`, for the next older page. Absent for the latest page.

room_id.description: The thread's room_id from the DM thread list (e.g. '!abc...:reddit.com'). Required.

name: reddit_dm_messages
title: DM Thread Messages
